params.comment: The Pages tab reads this repo's public page, the Quality page, at its Pages URL (the live site, built by .github/workflows/pages.yml). origin is the production URL; site_dir stays empty because the build writes quality/dist after the readings.

goal_source: Off: the repo holds no site source (no src folder); the Quality page is generated into quality/dist after the readings. Its params stay, because the other Design metrics read them. Reversal: delete drop when a site source is added.

params.comment: The usability metrics read the site from this entry: origin and site_dir match design.raw_hex. key_pages are the two pages the repo ships, written relative to origin because the site lives under /compute-crafter/ and a leading slash would leave it.
platform pages reads GitHub Pages deploys through the GitHub API.
